primary_finding: Different jaw linkage geometries can yield equivalent mechanical performance; morphological and functional divergence can be decoupled
aza3_transfer: functional landscape not trait-only tree; demand real performance equivalence
critical_limit: animal biomechanical analogy, not flower experiment

primary_finding: Resin pollinator reward lost in 5-6 reconstructions; resin apparently redeployed as male-flower defense in 3-4 lineages; defensive bract closure also noted
aza3_transfer: functions can be re-used across history; precedes own thesis idea
critical_limit: inferred histories do not prove exact causal origin of change

primary_finding: Larger showy bracts received more pollen but induced more egg laying by seed predators; net size selection tended to stabilize
aza3_transfer: strong same-taxon benchmark for plant fitness components and opposing agents
critical_limit: natural phenotypic selection not randomized bract causal manipulations

primary_finding: Bracts enhance warmth, UV/rain pollen protection, pollinator visits and offspring quality, while increasing larval seed predation
aza3_transfer: protection-attraction-predation costs already measured in a different family
critical_limit: bract removal changes multiple variables simultaneously; not Cirsium spines

primary_finding: Genomic transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses link translucent bracts to altered photosynthesis and flavonoid programs
aza3_transfer: benchmark for genetics of adaptive architecture after phenotype/fitness work
critical_limit: genomic association/expression does not identify selection on Cirsium architecture

primary_finding: Experimentally drained water-filled bracts show increased seed predation while no detected visitor discrimination
aza3_transfer: portal manipulation and positive/negative controls for enemy versus pollinator access
critical_limit: drainage adds a physical hole and cannot be treated as pure water removal; not a spine test

primary_finding: Greater corolla exsertion beyond bract correlates with higher stigma pollen load and higher seed predation
aza3_transfer: quantify both beneficial and harmful routes plus geography
critical_limit: observational corolla exsertion, not controlled phyllary-spine removal

evidence_theme: sequential pollination and seed predator filters
primary_finding: Six floral traits in common gardens: selection during seed initiation stronger than during predation; correlational selection mostly during initiation
aza3_transfer: two-stage selection with single-genotype-linked outcomes; preempts generic dual-stage novelty
critical_limit: not proof that every trait has opposing selection; original factors differ from Cirsium

evidence_theme: circadian trait switching and nursery pollination
primary_finding: Dusk flower opening, nectar and scent; morning access can compensate when nocturnal nursery pollinator Hadena shifts toward parasitism
aza3_transfer: temporal niche and alternative pollination channel analogue
critical_limit: time-dependent benefits not direct evidence for gravitation-mediated head movement

evidence_theme: climate direct and pollinator mediated trait evolution
primary_finding: Phylogenetic comparison finds direct climate links to calyx size plus climate association with pollinator distributions and nocturnal trait evolution
aza3_transfer: direct vs mediated climate effects need separate tests in own study
critical_limit: observational species-level association; no direct local site causality

primary_finding: 3D tomography and phylogenetic comparisons tie functional modules to pollinator changes, with modules associated with faster evolution of other flower parts
aza3_transfer: functional versus developmental modules and rates precede this PhD
critical_limit: different plant structure; not universal gene-level modularity proof

primary_finding: Bee-to-hummingbird sister comparison: extensive phenotypic change but largely similar efficiency-centered integration/modularity
aza3_transfer: strong counterexample to morphology change implying reorganization of modules
critical_limit: one sister-species contrast; phenotypic modularity not separate genotype loci

primary_finding: Flower-insect mimicry attraction module correlation tightens with specialization while other modules less integrated
aza3_transfer: flower function may assemble across heads without all parts co-changing
critical_limit: within-population morphological covariance not causal genotype modularity

primary_finding: Phylogenetic evidence that spur length increased during shifts to pollinators with longer tongues
aza3_transfer: precedes morphology-to-pollinator peak matching and niche shift thesis
critical_limit: one genus and particular spur axis; not Cirsium O/B evolution

primary_finding: Independent yellow morphs of red-flowered systems converge in color/expression and attract bees despite incomplete mechanical fit
aza3_transfer: order of component changes; attractive and functional fit modules can lag
critical_limit: bee preference not demonstration completed pollinator shift or lifetime fitness

primary_finding: Fruit/flower retention decreases with moth egg load and increases with successful pollination
aza3_transfer: same partner can pollinate and consume seeds; adapt success must include egg load
critical_limit: not about geometric bract orientation or inherited convergence

primary_finding: 3D printed flowers show plant pollen-transfer proxy and hawkmoth foraging performance have different optima in curvature and nectary diameter
aza3_transfer: estimate performance functions rather than inferring animal choice = plant benefit
critical_limit: robotic flower proxy; not actual plant reproductive fitness nor trait inheritance

primary_finding: Pollinator selection on floral traits stronger than other biotic agents, roughly similar to abiotic agents in experimental study meta-analysis
aza3_transfer: must keep abiotic rain/UV separate from observed insect mediation
critical_limit: heterogeneous studies and selection gradients; not Cirsium-specific

primary_finding: Adaptive generalization and novel trait combinations can mitigate visitor-specific fitness valleys
aza3_transfer: preempts claiming tradeoff mitigation or trait recombination as new theoretical idea
critical_limit: conceptual review; need tested predictions and appropriate functionality

primary_finding: Adaptive phenotype can optimize aggregate local pollen transfer rather than fit to most effective visitor; need whole fitness surfaces
aza3_transfer: community-conditioned functional optimum already explicit framework
critical_limit: review not independent causal proof that each thistle has this property

primary_finding: Across 27 populations pollinator assemblage axis predicts floral trait divergence without obligatory dominant guild replacement
aza3_transfer: replace only presence/absence with observed abundances and individual effectiveness
critical_limit: phylogeographic association rather than randomized partner swap

evidence_theme: pollination defense abiotic and temporal selection
primary_finding: Review synthesizes bract protection, attraction, UV/temperature, photosynthesis and developmental stage variation in selective agents
aza3_transfer: multi-function and ontogenetic change not new general concepts
critical_limit: review includes nonhomologous bracts; cannot use as own genus-specific test

primary_finding: 171 studies / 1348 records; herbivory alters flower traits, visitor response and reproduction in tissue- and damage-specific ways
aza3_transfer: need avoid assuming florivore suppression boosts net plants; quantify stage-specific tissue
critical_limit: aggregated effect not point estimate for focal head traits

system: Nicotiana alata N. forgetiana and F4 hybrids
primary_finding: Two relatively independent trait suites retained after four generations of recombination in hybrids
aza3_transfer: real module genetic evidence requires crosses/common background not RAD structure alone
critical_limit: different flowers; a direct Cirsium genome lego inference is not permitted
